disclosureQuote: Generative AI-assisted tools were used during development to assist with programming tasks and to create or refine selected 3D models. All AI-assisted code and 3D assets were reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated by the development team. AI-assisted tools were also used for selected Steam marketing artwork. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service.
summary: 把炮管当拳套使的单人坦克动作游戏。开发者披露生成式 AI 工具在开发期协助编程，并用于创建或打磨部分 3D 模型与部分 Steam 营销图，全部经团队审阅、编辑与测试；同时明确说明游玩时不产出 AI 生成内容、不连接外部 AI 服务。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Next Stage Inc.，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 86），首页有 4 个与 AI 直接相关的主题，已逐帖读取原文。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 4 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源（相关 Reddit 帖经 GitHub Actions 中转抓取返回 HTTP 403，读不到正文；其余结果只有商店页与跳转壳）。讨论区帖是玩家对 AI 制作的批评与争论，按规则只登记不判定，不改变任何领域结论；其中“整款游戏由 AI 生成”的说法与商店披露的“AI 协助部分代码、模型与营销图”并不一致。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作核查时尚未公布发售日。
description: 官方披露把 AI 用在编程协助、部分 3D 模型与部分商店营销图上，并声明游玩时不生成 AI 内容；讨论区存在集中的玩家批评。

english.summary: A single-player tank action game that swings its cannon like a fist. The developer states generative AI tools assisted programming tasks and were used to create or refine selected 3D models and selected Steam marketing artwork, all reviewed, edited and tested by the team, and states that the game does not generate content with AI during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Next Stage Inc., self-published) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 86), where four topics directly concern AI use; all four threads were opened and read in full. This title was searched 1 time with 4 results and 0 raw source(s) were read: the related Reddit thread returned HTTP 403 to the relay and the remaining results were store pages and google.com/goto redirect shells. The forum threads are player criticism and argument about AI use and are logged without changing any area finding; the claim that the whole game was generated by AI does not match the store disclosure, which limits AI to code assistance, selected 3D models and selected marketing artwork. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. No release date had been announced at review time.
